newsitem.title: ZAMBIA: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR TOPS TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZAMBIA STOCKS WEEK - ZAMBIA SUGAR TOPS TRADE.

text.p: Zambia Sugar was the most active
share on the Lusaka Stock Exchange last week helping to boost
volumes on the overall bourse where most stocks traded steady.
Traded volume rose to 138,435 shares worth 2.14 million
kwacha from 53,933 shares worth 1.18 million kwacha the previous
Zambia Sugar remained steady at 11 kwacha, its lowest level
in 12 months, after 117,347 shares worth 1.29 million kwacha
Amongst other shares Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines, which
last week saw an 80 percent stake in its Kanshansi copper mine
sold to a U.S. firm, was unchanged at 1,900 kwacha. Rothmans was
steady at 33 kwacha and Chilanga Cement lost one kwacha to 50.
